Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You notice the dry ground beneath the roots and the way the wind bends around the rise.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None — no roll
Time
Ten minutes of examination.
Target / range / shape
A campsite you can examine for ten minutes.
Duration
Information learned remains known.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Ordinary activities remain available without this card. Roll only when uncertainty has consequences.
Type
Skill / Utility

After examining a site, learn one present, observable environmental danger to camping there, if any, and one available way to shelter from it, if one exists. No roll. This does not reveal hidden creatures, create shelter or promise safety from later events.
